full_judgment: 15. I have also considered the deposition of the P.Ws. and of the O.P.Ws. and I find that, they have expressed their ignorance in respect of number of the suit plot, khatian number etc. These are matters of record and the P.Ws. as well as O.P.Ws. were entitled to refresh their memory from this deeds submitted before the trial court. So ignorance of these facts are not fatal, rather the parties were prevented by the provisions of section 91 of the Evidence Act, 1872, to dispute the contents of the documents of this deed No. 2769, dated 28.06.2005.
